title: Understanding Model Complexity
text: Model complexity refers to the number of parameters or the flexibility of a model. A more complex model can fit the training data more closely.

title: Impact of Model Complexity on Variance
text: As model complexity increases, the model can fit the training data more closely, which can lead to higher variance.

title: Understanding Sigma Squared
text: Sigma squared (σ²) represents the variance of the irreducible error, which is the noise inherent in the data.

title: Effect of Model Complexity on Sigma Squared
text: Model complexity does not affect the irreducible error (σ²) because this error is inherent in the data and cannot be reduced by changing the model.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Consider whether decreasing model complexity can reduce the irreducible error (σ²).
